tranches.name: Authority Account Context and Terminology Canonicalization
tranches.completion_gate: Universal-user and contextual-role authority is unambiguous, older global GM/Player assumptions are reconciled, and additive implementation touch points are identified without reopening completed Stage A closure evidence.

tranches.name: Asynchronous Action Proposal and GM Inbox Contract
tranches.completion_gate: One durable delayed proposal produces at most one attributable authoritative outcome through the existing proposal/approval architecture with safe stale conflict clarification reconnect and notification behavior.

tranches.name: Between-Session Campaign Activity and Bounded Downtime
tranches.completion_gate: A bounded alpha-useful activity layer is specified across governed downtime preparation advancement research investigation journal relationship crafting/repair and related owning domains without committing the project to full future breadth.

tranches.name: Personal Workspace and No-Campaign Home
tranches.completion_gate: A subscribed user with zero Campaign memberships has a useful governed Personal workspace and can move between Personal and Campaign contexts without authority bleed.

tranches.name: Creator Workshop Reusable Assets and Sandbox Lab
tranches.completion_gate: Reusable creation experimentation templates Campaign variants live instances and canonical promotion are distinct and permission/provenance safe.

tranches.name: Shell Navigation Notifications Visibility and Spoiler UX
tranches.completion_gate: Desktop mobile keyboard touch and screen-reader workflows make context role waiting work and information classification understandable without treating spoiler filtering as a security boundary.

tranches.name: Persistence Recovery Security and Hybrid Acceptance Architecture
tranches.completion_gate: Deterministic fixtures and acceptance contracts cover long-delay mixed-cadence cross-device revocation entitlement stale-version reconnect nonleakage and no-duplicate-mutation cases.

tranches.name: Implementation Handoff and Stage Alpha Integration
tranches.completion_gate: Implementation-ready additive slices migrations flags validators fixtures acceptance IDs dependencies and roadmap destinations are complete and merged without retroactively invalidating completed Stage A milestones.
